title: United Kingdom (starter profile)
note: Starter profile. Emergency numbers are filled in. The national NHS pages ("When to call 999", "When to go to A&E", reviewed 3 February 2023) do not currently list symptoms; lists are published by regional NHS ambulance services. Warning signs are pending transcription from an official NHS source. To be discussed and maintained by a community in this region.

emergency.message: If someone is seriously ill or injured and their life is at risk, call 999 now. If you need medical help urgently but it is not life-threatening, call NHS 111 or use NHS 111 online.
